title: Buying Near App State: Boone NC Real Estate Guide
excerpt: If your student just committed to App State, you may be wondering whether buying a home in Boone makes more sense than paying rent for four years. A local High Country REALTOR® breaks down everything out-of-state families need to know before making the move.
